title: Connect the dots backwards
subtitle: Paths, mixing disciplines, learning as a lifelong skill, and why to read this on paper. 14 panels.
book_version: v1.0.0 is the only official version; the second edition is in release candidates (rc1 and rc2 frozen)
by: gen-z.journalist, 18 October 2026, from Dinis's memo on paths and learning
rule: Every line the Guide says, and every quote card, is Dinis's words from the article 'Connect the dots backwards', word for word, including the Jobs quote as the article gives it; the build checks it.

cast.says: I can't see where any of this goes.
you can't connect the dots looking forward; you can only connect them looking backwards
